from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

# armchair mask:
def get_armchair(arr):
    # R ~ 90-120, G ~ 95-125, B ~ 100-135
    m = (arr[:, :, 0] > 85) & (arr[:, :, 0] < 125) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 90) & (arr[:, :, 1] < 130) & (arr[:, :, 2] > 95) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 140)
    y, x = np.where(m)
    return x, y

for f in ["obs_0018", "obs_0019", "obs_0020"]:
    arr = np.array(Image.open(f"/work/observations/{f}.png"))

'
